name: hitch-openai
description: OpenAI-compatible Hitch API tools: list models and chat completions via Bearer auth.

HITCH_API_KEY.title: Hitch API key
HITCH_API_KEY.description: Bearer token for https://hitch.genoventures.com/v1 (or HITCH_BASE_URL). Required for chat; preferred over OPENAI_API_KEY.

HITCH_BASE_URL.title: Hitch base URL
HITCH_BASE_URL.description: Optional OpenAI-compat base URL including /v1. Default: https://hitch.genoventures.com/v1. Trailing slash is stripped; do not append an extra /v1.
